# VDS Verify

> VDS Verify is a free iOS and Android app by Stelau Conseil (France) that decodes and verifies Visible Digital Seals (VDS, in French "Cachets Électroniques Visibles" or CEV): 2D-Doc (ANTS), AFNOR XP Z42-105 and ISO 22376:2023. It scans the Datamatrix or QR Code printed on a document, checks the electronic signature and the signing certificate against the ANTS trusted list, and displays the decoded data.

Key facts:

- Publisher: Stelau Conseil, France (https://www.stelau.com). Contact: contact@stelau.com
- Price: free, no account, no ads. Platforms: iPhone (App Store id6463440128) and Android (package com.stelau.vdsverify).
- Supported formats: every 2D-Doc; every VDS compliant with AFNOR XP Z42-105; every VDS compliant with ISO 22376:2023.
- Typical documents: French national ID card, France Identité single-use identity proof ("justificatif d'identité"), France Identité certified digital identity request, restricted information statement (RIR), driving entitlement certificate (ADCS), recreational boat licence, Crit'Air sticker, energy and phone bills.
- Verification steps: scan and decode the 2D code; fetch signing certificates from the ANTS Trusted List; check certificate validity and revocation; verify the seal signature; display decoded data and signature details.
- Privacy: the decoding API processes seals in memory only, stores nothing and keeps no logs. Scan history stays on the user's phone.
- Stelau also provides a VDS issuing API (create, encode, sign with qualified certificates, HSM compatible, manifest management) and a mobile verification SDK.
- Production references: Stelau's verification SDK ships in the France Identité app (5M+ users); Stelau's API is the one used by France Identité to issue its VDS (identity proofs, SNCF face-to-face checks) and by the official France Titres (ANTS) 2D-Doc verification service (https://web.2ddoc.services.ants.gouv.fr/).

- [2D-Doc verification (EN)](https://vds-verify.stelau.com/en/2d-doc-verification.html): how to verify a 2D-Doc, standards, documents, API and SDK
- [FAQ (FR)](https://vds-verify.stelau.com/faq-fr.html): qu'est-ce qu'un CEV, documents pris en charge, fonctionnement, confidentialité
- [FAQ (EN)](https://vds-verify.stelau.com/faq-en.html): what a VDS is, supported documents, how verification works, privacy
